name: Creality HP-TPU @BBL A1
filament_notes:
Creality manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 70 C for 12 h.
Manufacturer max speed 120 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 10.8 mm3/s (printer profile 3.2) from the manufacturer's 120 mm/s rating.
Product page: recommended 210-240C, 30-120 mm/s, 1.75+/-0.05 mm; 'better with Creality direct extrusion kit'. Bed and Shore hardness not published. fan_pct from K2 Plus profile (100%); K2 Plus profile 220C/40C bed, 3 mm3/s, retraction 1.2 mm; K1 table 215C/30C bed/75 mm/s/6 mm3/s. Creality wiki: do not feed TPU through CFS; TPU of 80A or softer not recommended on Creality printers; avoid long PTFE paths. Creality wiki drying guide (generic TPU row): drying 'must'; Creality dryer 70C 8-12h, blast dryer 65-75C 8h.
Source: https://store.creality.com/products/hp-tpu-fdm-3d-printer-filament-1-75mm-1kg
